construction: Human-authored question blueprints tied to scenario ground truth, not retriever results.

questions.question: Which release introduced the owner checklist before invitations?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: The February 5 checklist clarifies owner verification before invites.

questions.question: When did portfolio filters become available?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: March 5, 2025.

questions.question: What default selection did the April summary change use?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Shared boards were selected by default.

questions.question: How are seats archived during a billing cycle counted?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: They remain counted until the cycle closes.

questions.question: What changed in the June connector release?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Reconnect flow and sync status display changed.

questions.question: Where is the shared starter gallery located?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: In the workspace menu.

questions.question: What did the August portfolio update target?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: A faster aggregation path for large workspaces.

questions.question: What should remain timely after project alert controls are adjusted?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Critical and direct-mention alerts.

questions.question: Does the team invitation specification say every invitee verifies the owner?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: No. The owner verification should not repeat for each invitee.

questions.question: Which two portfolio concerns are separated in the product specification?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Large-workspace loading and visible filter state.

questions.question: Does the connector specification treat spreadsheet import as live sync?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: No; CSV import mapping is a separate workflow.

questions.question: What evidence does finance need beyond an invoice adjustment line?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Invoice-time seat evidence.

questions.question: Which two notification failure modes does the specification separate?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Too many routine digests and delayed urgent alerts.

questions.question: What controls whether a person may copy a team starter?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Workspace role permissions.

questions.question: Did any customer say a replacement sign-in email had gone stale?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Yes; a customer reported an expired or stale password-reset link.

questions.question: What evidence suggests people invited to a workspace can get stuck even when its owner has completed setup?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Invitees report loops or repeated setup despite an owner-complete checklist.

questions.question: Find a customer account of a credential recovery message arriving too late to be useful.
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: A password-reset link expired or became stale.

questions.question: Is there evidence that corporate identity configuration, rather than a password, blocked access?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: SAML certificate, callback, domain, or tenant settings caused sign-in problems.

questions.question: What did teams observe when their sales system appeared connected but work items were absent?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: A green or successful sync status accompanied missing or stale records.

questions.question: Find evidence that a one-off spreadsheet upload placed data in incorrect fields.
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: CSV column mapping put values in the wrong fields.

questions.question: How did people with many shared boards react to the spring email summary behavior?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: They received too many routine emails, especially across several boards.

questions.question: Can a calmer inbox coincide with a missed escalation?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Yes; later reports describe delayed urgent alerts or mentions.

questions.question: Find a report of leadership waiting on a cross-project view before a meeting.
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Large-workspace portfolio loading delayed review meetings.

questions.question: Did anyone mistake a hidden selection for absent chart data?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Yes; an applied or hidden filter led to an incorrect impression of missing data.

questions.question: Why might finance see more billed people than the current active roster?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Archived seats remain billed until the cycle ends; invoice and current roster may differ.

questions.question: Did anyone recreate a standard board because they could not locate the starter?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Yes; people missed the gallery and rebuilt a board.

questions.question: Find a case where the shared starter was visible but unusable to a teammate.
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: A role restriction disabled duplication despite visible templates.

questions.question: Are there customer accounts of work being done in spreadsheets while a connected sales feed lagged?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Yes; teams used spreadsheets when connector updates were missing.

questions.question: Find complaints about repeated entry steps from people other than workspace owners.
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Invited team members, not only owners, faced repeat steps.

questions.question: Did anyone need to amend member permissions to use a board starter?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Changing a member role resolved template copying for at least one customer.

questions.question: How should an investigator distinguish three reasons someone cannot sign in?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Invitation handoff, password recovery, and SSO configuration are distinct. Inspect context before assigning cause.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: What changed in July, and why could someone still fail to start from a shared board?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: The gallery launched; discoverability and role permissions remained separate barriers.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: How could customer reactions to the April email change differ with workspace size?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Shared boards were included by default; one-board users could like it while multi-board users received too many summaries.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: What evidence separates stale sales records from a corrupted spreadsheet import?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Live connector reports absent or stale records; CSV upload reports wrong field mapping.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: How did the August performance release relate to earlier large-workspace complaints?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: The release targeted large-workspace aggregation after earlier slow-view complaints; improvement reports exist but are not universal.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: Why might a dashboard look wrong even when it loads quickly?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: A hidden or stale filter can make data appear absent, separate from slow loading.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: What evidence would explain a discrepancy between finance's invoice and the admin roster?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Mid-cycle archived seats remain counted and invoice-time seat evidence is needed.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: How did September controls address one alert complaint while leaving another concern to investigate?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Per-project controls reduced routine noise; later reports of delayed critical alerts require investigation.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: What supports a cautious timeline for missing sales tasks after the June connector change?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Reports followed the refresh, but the release notes and reports do not prove the update caused missing records.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: Where can a PM find evidence that onboarding and collaboration problems overlap?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Invitation handoff and starter discovery can both interrupt initial team setup, but they have different mechanisms.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: Did the spring summaries make everyone's inbox worse?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: No. Some customers liked the digest, while others with many boards saw too much email.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: Was every large-workspace portfolio view still slow after August?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: No universal conclusion. Some reported relief; later performance needs separate evidence.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: Can all failed sign-ins be attributed to the owner checklist?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: No. Password recovery and SSO settings also account for access reports.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: Did a green connector status prove all sales records arrived?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: No. Customers reported missing records despite successful status; root cause remains uncertain.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.question: Do the later notification reports prove the September controls delayed urgent alerts?
questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: No. Reports occurred afterward, but causation is not established.
questions.notes: Corroborate with source dates; reports alone do not establish causality.

questions.expected_answer_or_abstention: Abstain: no real customers or churn data exist in this synthetic corpus.
